title: run-evaluator input
description: One measurement request. The candidate is measured as it stands; this skill edits nothing.

op.description: Operator id whose operators/<op>/spec.yaml supplies shapes and tolerances.

candidate.description: Kernel module to measure: absolute, or relative to the RSI root or the operator directory.

exp_kind.description: evaluate (default) measures a candidate; operator_baseline records experiment zero for the operator.

out.description: Where the signed result is written.

timeout_s.description: Wall-clock cap for one evaluator run.
